description: Use when an agent must see who is buying or dumping a Base ERC-20 now (smart money, whales, who bought/sold). Input: token address, optional wallet, minutes (1-60), limit. Output: JSON signal (smart money accumulating vs retail), whale/shark/dolphin/fish flow buckets, who bought/sold with own labels, notable wallets, recent + largest swaps, DEX netflow, pools. On-chain only; address ≠ person. Example: ?address=0x4ed4E862860beD51a9570b96d89aF5E1B0Efefed Price: $0.018 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

address.description: ERC-20 token contract on Base mainnet. EOA → 400, non-ERC-20 → 422 (not charged)

minutes.description: Look-back window in minutes (default 60). Very busy tokens are cut short; see window.complete

wallet.description: Optional wallet to drill into: its received/sent/net and DEX bought/sold in the window

name: base_token_flows
title: Base smart-money tracker: who bought / who sold, whale vs retail flow, labeled wallets, last 60 min
